items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: Joe Thomas still St. Anne Street. I have to get his number.

ctx.x: I'd like to inquire if you have a list of the addresses. We could even put it on the tape and then we can take it off of the tape. If you have the other members of the band that we've interviewed, I don't think I'd ever call him as Fernand as Mr. Walters. Walters, Alba Walters. We had a short interview with him and one with Louis Barbaran. And you I believe are the only members now that we've interviewed. Let's see there's…
Joe Thomas. Somehow we've missed him all the time.
